name: Surface parking lot
summary: Surface lot cost per space is driven by paved area per space (250-350 SF incl. aisles), pavement section (asphalt vs. concrete), storm drainage/detention, lighting and code landscaping. Public data is thin: one 2024 municipal engineer's estimate (~$5.3k/space), a VTPI calculator default ($5k suburban / $10k urban, 2022) and a 2025-26 university lot with full campus standards (~$15.5k/space). Default is a reasoned midpoint — medium-low confidence.

typicalSize.method: Public examples: La Vista NE 86 spaces (e1), UCF 59 spaces (e2). Commercial/retail lots commonly 100-500 spaces. Mid 150 is judgment.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: VTPI: off-street parking 'typically requires 250-350 square feet ... per space, including access lanes and landscaping' (e4). High 400 allows for perimeter landscape/detention on small or odd-shaped lots. SF here = paved/lot area, not building area.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: VTPI: 125-175 spaces per acre by design, but a survey of six typical lots averaged 85 per acre (e4). Mid 115 between the practical average and design efficiency.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Evidence: La Vista NE engineer's estimate 2024 $452,243 / 86 = $5,259/space (e1); VTPI 2022 calculator: suburban surface $5,000, urban/CBD surface $10,000 construction per space (e3); UCF E-1 lot 2025 $914,813 / 59 = $15,505/space (e2, full campus standards, small lot). Bottom-up check at 330 SF/space: grading/base/asphalt ~$7-9/SF + curb, storm drainage ~$3-5/SF + lighting/striping/landscape ~$2-4/SF = ~$12-18/SF -> ~$4,000-6,000; plus detention/stormwater quality typical of new lots -> mid $6,500. Low = suburban asphalt on flat site with existing drainage; high = UCF-type small lot with concrete, full stormwater, lighting and landscape.

perSF.method: perPrimaryUnit / sfPerPrimaryUnit of paved lot area: 4,000/300 = ~13; 6,500/330 = ~20; 15,500/390 = ~40. $/SF of lot area, not building area.

scope.notes: Contractor price for clearing/grading, aggregate base, asphalt paving, curb & gutter, on-site storm drainage, LED pole lighting, striping/signage and code landscaping islands, incl. GC and OH&P. Excludes land, design, off-site improvements, impact fees, PARCS and EV charging (line items).

qualityTiers.method: low/mid = 4,000/6,500 = 0.62 (rounded 0.65); premium ~ urban surface (VTPI $10,000 vs $6,500 ~ 1.5); luxury = high/mid 15,500/6,500 = 2.4 (concrete, pervious pavers, heavy landscape, full stormwater).

systemSplit.method: Derived from the bottom-up per-space build in hardCost.method: paving/base/curb/striping/landscape (32) ~45%; clearing, grading, erosion control (31) ~20%; storm drainage and detention (33) ~15%; site lighting (26) ~12%; general conditions/mobilization (01) ~8%. Verify against a local bid tab.

lineItems.name: Stormwater detention / water-quality BMP (pond, underground vault or bioretention)

cost.method: Estimating judgment: varies with impervious area and local criteria; underground vaults at the high end. Typical new lots over ~1 acre trigger detention. Not separately sourced — verify with civil engineer.

lineItems.notes: Switch on where the jurisdiction requires on-site detention not already captured by the default mid.

lineItems.name: Upgrade asphalt to concrete pavement

cost.method: Estimating judgment: concrete typically ~$3-9/SF more than asphalt over ~330 SF/space. Verify locally.

lineItems.notes: Common in Texas/Florida and for heavy-truck areas.

lineItems.name: EV charging — Level 2 port incl. conduit, trenching and electrical service share

cost.method: Estimating judgment for networked L2 in a surface lot (trenching adds cost vs. garage). Default 5% of spaces; set to local mandate.

lineItems.notes: Many codes now require EV-capable conduit for a share of spaces.

cost.method: Estimating judgment: pay station ~$15k each to gated lane ~$75-100k. Only for paid lots.

pctOfHard.method: UCF E-1 lot: design cost $131,236 on construction $914,813 = 14.3% (e2). Small municipal lots run lower (civil design + survey + geotech + permits ~10%); small/complex lots up to 20%.

softCosts.notes: Mostly civil engineering, survey, geotech, stormwater permitting and materials testing.

hard.method: Unforeseen subgrade (undercut/replacement) is the main risk in surface lots; 5-12% typical owner contingency (judgment).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Hard low $4,000 x 1.10 soft ~ $4,400 (min 4,000 allows for very simple lots); UCF all-in $18,947/space (e2) plus contingency headroom -> max ~$22,000.

source.title: Agenda Item C — Advertisement for Bids: Surface Parking Lot, La Vista City Centre Replat Three (July 2, 2024)

evidence.quote: The proposed parking lot will provide 86 additional surface parking spaces for the La Vista City Centre area. The Engineer's estimate for the proposed work is $452,242.56.
evidence.scopeNotes: Engineer's estimate (not award). $452,242.56 / 86 = $5,259/space (our arithmetic). Quote text seen in the search excerpt of the staff report; the resolution page confirming the July 2024 bid schedule was read directly.

source.title: Project cost sheet — Creation of E-1 Surface Parking Lot (Project 24134001)
source.publisher: University of Central Florida Facilities & Safety

evidence.quote: NUMBER OF NEW PARKING SPACES: 59 ... COST PER PARKING SPACE: $18,946.58 ... DESIGN COST 131,235.65 ... CONSTRUCTION COST 914,812.78
evidence.scopeNotes: Construction $914,812.78 / 59 = $15,505/space (our arithmetic); $18,947/space is total incl. design. University standards, small lot; completed ~Jan 2026 so dollars treated as 2025.
